description: 15 §2.7 row OpenCode HTTP, §4.6 Ask / answer and Keys (S-011-1, person-run server, OpenCode 1.18.32): the event stream of one turn whose write tool asks edit permission. the person's prompt part is one person message, then busy is status working (the recorded order) keyed opencode:opencode:<sessionId>:<partId>; the write tool part is activity started then failed (rejected), keyed by its part id, its summary the tool name only (never its input); permission.asked is one permission ask on the driver channel keyed by the permission id, with Allow once and Deny reject both possible; permission.replied claims nothing (answeredElsewhere U→no, SP-09); the completed assistant message is one sealed fidelity-1 usage observation keyed by its message id; idle is status idle. Every other event (session.updated, session.diff, plugin.added, catalog.updated, deltas, reasoning, step parts, session.idle) is skipped; no turn.ended (turnEnd none until S-021-2). The Deny this run sent is the reply body reject.

record.text: Create a file named deny-probe.txt in the current directory containing the single word probe, using your file-writing tool. If the write is refused, reply with the word refused and stop.
